raw_text: Markus is doing a doctorate in glaciology at ETH Zurich. He is the one who keeps sending me alpine routes I would never have found on my own.

units.authoritative_content: Markus is doing a doctorate in glaciology at ETH Zurich. He is the one who keeps sending me alpine routes I would never have found on my own.

semantic.meaning: A personal note about a friend or acquaintance named Markus, who is pursuing a PhD in glaciology at ETH Zurich and serves as a primary source for alpine hiking routes for the narrator.

definitions.definition: the scientific study of glaciers and ice
